_notes: foil_gold/foil_silver/shiny_panel follow the established Rosetta/M4V naming convention. tex_01.stl was visually inspected and shows two long segmented wing arrays (~12m wide), matching Deep Space 1's distinctive large solar concentrator array. black_krinkle.stl was left Unknown, matching the precedent set by Rosetta itself (Rosetta's own component_map.json leaves its black/black_krinkle meshes unmapped).
_bus_note: black_krinkle.stl is a single compact 1.19 x 0.95 x 1.03 m box at the model centre - the spacecraft bus under black MLI.
